# Geonwoo Jeong

Geonwoo Jeong is based in Tokyo, Japan and is affiliated with KINTO Technologies.

Geonwoo builds software with clear interfaces, explicit boundaries, and documentation that evolves alongside the systems it describes.

Coding agents are used throughout development and are given room to reason and plan. Well-defined operations are moved into tools that both humans and agents can inspect and use. CLIs, APIs, schemas, and workflows keep execution concrete and reproducible.

Agents decide what happens next. Interfaces define how it happens.

Flexible reasoning above; predictable execution below.

Primary interests include developer tools, language, and agent-aware software that remains understandable and safe to change.
